portableBrowserChecks: opens a single downloaded HTML offline with a touch-friendly quick setup
quick start includes Prota in the selected count and preserves class selection
only the visible portrait capture allocates pixels; 720p uses 56% fewer pixels than full HD
touch actions and class powers reach the command history
all three game modes start from the same engine
128 fighters run with all classes and visible local commands
drawing quality changes do not change a seeded combat outcome
settings retain rules, class radar and pause/resume behavior
rotating a phone keeps a horizontal action bar and moves the same joystick into the active view
profile settings survive reopening the downloaded file
returning from another app resets the wall clock without changing a manual pause
no network request is needed for scripts, fonts, styles or gameplay
still runs with blocked file storage and on a narrow phone

environment: Chromium software rendering; touch and phone viewport emulation, not a physical phone or GPU
scope: Downloaded file tested with file://, offline, portrait/landscape, touch input and 128 fighters. Same seeded combat state at 540p/30 and 1080p/60. No real LIVE, physical phone, WebKit or physical GPU test. Measured draw CPU timing is not phone FPS.
